name: BG1.4 chat: base.tkt decided moke's own origin answers for loke, so window.LOKE_URL is ''
BG1.4 chat: a message sent through the page gets loke's reply, through moke's /api/pipeline
js: await (async()=>{const of=window.fetch;let cap=null;window.fetch=async function(u,o){const r=await of.apply(this,arguments);if(String(u).indexOf('/api/pipeline')>=0){cap={url:String(u),status:r.status,body:await r.clone().text()};}return r;};try{const i=document.getElementById('chat-input');i.value='summarise the weather data for the week please';submitMessage();for(let k=0;k<80&&!cap;k++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));let ok=false,j=null;if(cap){try{j=JSON.parse(cap.body);}catch(e){}}for(let k=0;k<40&&j&&j.response;k++){if(document.body.innerText.indexOf(String(j.response).slice(0,24))>=0){ok=true;break;}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));}return (cap&&cap.url==='/api/pipeline'&&cap.status===200&&j&&j.ok===true&&ok)||JSON.stringify({cap:cap&&{url:cap.url,status:cap.status,body:cap.body.slice(0,200)},shown:ok});}finally{window.fetch=of;}})()

name: BG1.4 chat: the issue form's AI draft asks moke's /api/pipeline (answered by this check, not sent: loke's router may send its prompt to a cloud model) and shows the answer
js: await (async()=>{const of=window.fetch;const seen=[];window.fetch=function(u,o){if(String(u).indexOf('/api/pipeline')>=0){seen.push(String(u));return Promise.resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify({ok:true,response:'bg14 drafted description'}),{status:200,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}}));}return of.apply(this,arguments);};try{document.getElementById('issue-title').value='bg14 the chart is blank';aiDraftDescription();const pv=document.getElementById('issue-ai-preview');for(let k=0;k<40&&pv.style.display!=='block';k++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));const t=document.getElementById('issue-ai-text').textContent;return (seen.length===1&&seen[0]==='/api/pipeline'&&pv.style.display==='block'&&t==='bg14 drafted description')||JSON.stringify({seen,display:pv.style.display,text:t});}finally{window.fetch=of;}})()

js: await (async()=>{for(let k=0;k<40&&!/^\{/.test(document.body.textContent.trim());k++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));let j=null;try{j=JSON.parse(document.body.textContent);}catch(e){}const here=location.href.split('#')[0];const api=(window.__uiRequests||[]).filter(r=>(r.type==='Fetch'||r.type==='XHR'||r.type==='EventSource')&&r.page.split('#')[0]===here);const away=api.filter(r=>new URL(r.url).origin!==location.origin&&!(u=>u.startsWith('http://localhost:11434/'))(r.url));const paths=api.filter(r=>new URL(r.url).origin===location.origin).map(r=>r.method+' '+new URL(r.url).pathname);return (j&&j.ok===true&&away.length===0&&paths.indexOf('GET /api/health')>=0)||JSON.stringify({body:document.body.textContent.slice(0,200),away:away.map(r=>r.method+' '+r.url),paths});})()
